questions.question: What is the only way to lower your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?

options.text: Drink coffee.
Exercise.
Wait for your body to process the alcohol.
Take a cold shower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for your body to process the alcohol.
questions.explanation: Only time will lower your BAC. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers cannot reduce your BAC or make you sober. They may help you stay awake, but they do not affect your alcohol level.

questions.question: Is it wise to always work on improving your driving and observation skills?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: Driving is always risky. Drivers who think they have nothing to improve become unsafe. Always try to improve your driving and observation skills for your safety and the safety of others.

questions.question: You are angry after a problem at work. When you reach your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the highway to let off steam.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Stop at a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait before driving. Letting emotions affect your driving is very dangerous for you and others on the road.

questions.question: A person walking with a white cane or guide dog is likely:

options.text: Deaf.
Part of a traffic study.
Blind.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blind.
questions.explanation: Drivers must always let blind pedestrians cross first. A white cane or guide dog is a sign of a blind person.

questions.question: After drinking several beers, how can you reduce the effects of alcohol?

options.text: Take a cold shower.
Wait several hours.
Drink several cups of coffee.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait several hours.
questions.explanation: Only time reduces the effects of alcohol. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers do not speed this up. Your body needs about one hour to process each drink.

questions.question: Why should you not stop suddenly in front of large trucks and buses?

options.text: Drivers of small vehicles cannot see large trucks and buses in their rearview mirrors.
Large trucks and buses need more distance to stop because of their size and weight.
Large trucks and buses travel faster than small vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Large trucks and buses need more distance to stop because of their size and weight.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles need longer distances to stop and speed up. If you stop suddenly in front of one, the driver may not have time to avoid hitting you.

questions.question: What should you do when an emergency vehicle with flashing red or blue lights is approaching?

options.text: Try to reach your destination before it catches up.
Keep driving but try to stay out of its way.
Pull to the side of the road and stop completely.
Stop in the middle of an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the side of the road and stop completely.
questions.explanation: Always let emergency vehicles pass. Pull to the right edge of the road and stop. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first, then pull over.

questions.question: When a blind pedestrian with a guide dog or white cane crosses the street:

options.text: You must always let them cross first.
You must tell them where to cross.
You only have to let them cross at a corner.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must always let them cross first.
questions.explanation: Blind people use white canes or guide dogs. You must always let them cross, no matter where they are crossing.

questions.question: How can you identify an aggressive driver?

options.text: They make sudden, improper lane changes.
The number of passengers in their car.
They drive slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: They make sudden, improper lane changes.
questions.explanation: Watch other drivers on the road. An aggressive driver makes sudden or improper lane changes. Do not challenge them. Get out of their way.

questions.question: If pedestrians cross the street illegally instead of in a crosswalk, you:

options.text: Must stop for them.
Do not have to stop for them.
Should honk your horn at them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop for them.
questions.explanation: Always stop for pedestrians, even if they are crossing illegally or in the wrong place.

questions.question: Who must wear a seat belt?

options.text: The driver
Front seat passengers
Children under age 13
All of the above

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: Oklahoma law requires all front seat passengers to wear seat belts. Children under 13 must wear seat belts in any seat.

questions.question: How should you safely cross a railroad track?

options.text: Look both ways, but only when the red light is flashing.
Listen, look both ways, and then go if it is safe.
Cross quickly when a train is approaching.
Quickly pass under any lowering gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Listen, look both ways, and then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are very dangerous. Always look and listen for trains coming from both directions before crossing. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Low clearance.
Fines double in a work zone.
No left turn.
Do not block intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road has low clearance.

questions.question: What should you do if traffic is blocking an intersection?

options.text: Use your horn to get traffic to move.
Drive close to the car ahead in case the light turns red.
Wait to enter until you can cross the intersection completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait to enter until you can cross the intersection completely.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection unless you can drive all the way through without stopping. Wait for traffic ahead to clear.

questions.question: What should you do if a police officer stops you?

options.text: Unbuckle your seat belt and lower your window.
Get your paperwork ready before the officer reaches your car.
Stay in your car with your hands on the steering wheel and wait for the officer.
Get out of your car and walk toward the patrol car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car with your hands on the steering wheel and wait for the officer.
questions.explanation: Keep your hands on the wheel. Keep your passengers' hands in view too. Stay in your vehicle unless the officer tells you to get out. Wait for the officer to ask for your license, registration, and insurance.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while driving?

options.text: Get some coffee.
Open your window.
Stop driving.
Turn on the radio.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop driving.
questions.explanation: Tired driving is as dangerous as drunk driving. If you feel tired, stop driving.

questions.question: What color are temporary signs in construction work zones?

options.text: Red background with green writing.
Orange background with black writing.
Yellow background with blue writing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Orange background with black writing.
questions.explanation: All temporary signs in work zones have orange backgrounds with black writing or symbols.

questions.question: How should you drive safely at night?

options.text: Increase your following distance.
Do not drive if you are tired.
Make sure your headlights work properly.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: It is harder to see at night. Take steps to keep yourself and other drivers safe in the dark.

questions.question: What is a driving distraction?

options.text: Anything that causes you to swerve while driving.
Anything that takes your attention away from driving.
Anything that causes you to pay more attention to driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Anything that takes your attention away from driving.
questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving. Distractions can cause accidents, injuries, and death.

questions.question: What should a driver do when entering public traffic from a driveway?

options.text: Has the right-of-way.
Should yield to drivers already on the public road.
May force their way into traffic.
Can assume that other drivers will change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should yield to drivers already on the public road.
questions.explanation: When entering traffic from a driveway or private road, yield to drivers on the public road. Merge safely when you can.
